question: Which Indian shooter made history by winning bronze in men’s trap at the ISSF World Championship Shotgun 2025 in Athens, Greece, becoming India’s third medalist in the event’s history?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zoravar Singh Sandhu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Zoravar Singh Sandhu won bronze in men’s trap at the ISSF World Championship Shotgun 2025 in Athens, Greece, marking India’s third medal in men’s trap at the World Championships.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Zoravar hit 31 of 50 targets in the final, competing in challenging weather and light conditions.**
 
• **He finished behind Croatia’s Josip Glasnovic (gold) and Spain’s Andres Garcia (silver).**
 
• **This bronze is India’s third medal in men’s trap shooting at the Shotgun World Championships.**
 
• **The National Rifle Association of India President Kalikesh Singh Deo praised Zoravar’s dedication and the efforts of coach Peter Wilson’s team.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **ISSF World Championship Shotgun**__

 __
 
• Organized by the International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF), one of the most prestigious events in shooting sports.
 
• Features events like men’s and women’s trap, skeet, and double trap shooting.
 
• Serves as a qualifying event for the Olympic Games.
 
 
 
• **Zoravar Singh Sandhu**__
 __
 
• Emerging Indian trap shooter who made a mark with his ISSF World Championship 2025 performance.
 
• Coached by Peter Wilson, a renowned figure in the sport.
 
 
 
• **Historic Medals in Indian Trap Shooting**__
 __
 
• Manavjeet Singh Sandhu – Gold in men’s trap at Zagreb 2006.
 
• Karni Singh – Silver in men’s trap at Cairo 1962.
 
 
 
• **National Rifle Association of India (NRAI)**__
 
 
• The apex body for shooting sports in India.
 
• Responsible for organizing national competitions, promoting shooting, and managing Indian participation in international events.
